_readme: Copy this file to accounts.json and fill only the accounts you use. Keep accounts.json private: anyone with your USB drive can read it. Prefer app passwords and narrowly scoped tokens, and revoke them if the drive is lost.

webhook._note: Send approved posts to Make, Zapier, n8n, IFTTT or Buffer to reach Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads and anything else.
